rules.statement: A person aggrieved by a preliminary or interlocutory order made by a Court of requests under section 4 of the Partition Ordinance has the right to appeal at once to the Supreme Court.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think he is entitled to appeal. Section 19 of the Ordinance gives an appeal from 'all decisions and orders of any Court made under the authority of the Ordinance.'"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 19 of the Partition Ordinance, No. 10 of 1863
